subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

INCREASE
solution:
The correct answer is: diminish

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Increase **means a rise in the number, amount or level of something.

 
 
• Example - *There has been a sharp **increase **of nearly 50% on last year’s figures.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Diminish means to become or to make something smaller or less important; decrease.
 
• Example - *The world’s rainforests are **diminishing **fast.*
 
• It is clear that 'Increase' and 'Diminish' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 1.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Expand means to become or to make something bigger.
 
• Widen means to become wider; to make something wider.
 
• Collect means to get and keep together a number of objects of a particular type over a period of time as a hobby.
